review.evidence: The original 2026-08-15 review start is retained. The separately pinned upgrade controller is a 3-of-5 Squads vault rather than a plain keypair; it can still replace mint-critical program logic without delay, so economicCapSemantics remains unbounded. Solayer's sUSD FAQ documents a continuous transaction-level mint gate: the Solayer sUSD Program issues the sUSD liability only after a qualified liquidity provider supplies a wrapped-T-Bill proof against the user's locked USDC; the Solayer program performs this supply-to-collateral reconciliation on each mint, rather than a named independent examiner.
